basic_info.description: ENTER AT 30 MASON ST.  Experience chic industrial living in this central city beauty! This bright condo offers an expansive feel with its tall ceilings and massive windows throughout, flooding the space with natural light. The home features a spacious one bedroom with large closet, lovely office/bonus space and large additional closet, (perfect for an exercise bike or extra wall of wardrobes) The modern kitchen is stunning with stainless steel appliances and a breakfast bar. The living room is perfect for relaxing and entertaining. Enjoy the convenience of an in-unit washer/dryer. Situated in a gorgeous historic yet modern elevator building, this prime location puts you close to tech offices, San Francisco Centre, the new IKEA store with lovely restaurant, and numerous transportation options. Become part of the vibrant heart of San Francisco and find your new home at 942 Market St! Building offers convenient bike Storage and unit also comes with private Storage cage! Leased Parking available right across the street for $400 a month.  This one has it all!
